statement: For finite simple connected 4-regular graphs on exactly 16 vertices having a cut vertex, the maximum number of Eulerian orientations is M_sep(16)=9216. Up to ordinary graph isomorphism there is exactly one maximizing graph; its canonical graph6 string is Osc??KF@wKK?W@W@b@?oP. Consequently the proposed inequality M_sep(16) <= 9147 is false, with excess 69.
contribution: A complete structural reduction to pairs of degree-(2,4,...,4) rooted blocks; an isomorph-free nauty census of every possible block and all 1,167 merged target graphs; exact integer orientation counts; equality classification; and canonical graph6 data. Independent signed-incidence and NetworkX/shortg implementations recount every retained block, verify the full merged census, and recheck the unique extremizer. No global priority claim is made before literature and referee review.
